chem_qa.task: Answer general chemistry questions concisely and correctly.
chem_qa.io_format: Assistant reply is exactly two lines: 'ANSWER: <short answer>' then 'WHY: <one-sentence justification>'.
success_criteria: Follows the two-line ANSWER/WHY format exactly, with no extra text
WHY is one sentence of at most 30 words
For ambiguous questions, ANSWER is a clarifying question that asks for the missing information
edge_cases: Trick or false-premise questions (the answer corrects the premise)
Ambiguous questions (ANSWER asks for the missing information)
chem_qa.title: Concise chemistry answers (ANSWER/WHY)

input.description: One chemistry question in plain English.

output.description: Assistant reply is exactly two lines: 'ANSWER: <short answer>' then 'WHY: <one-sentence justification>'.

seed_examples.input: What is the pH of 0.001 M NaOH at 25 °C?

scoring.judge_rubric: 1 if ANSWER is correct (same value and units as the reference, or a correct clarifying question for ambiguous items), else 0. Ignore WHY wording.

pubmed_extract.title: Extract drug-trial facts from PubMed abstracts as JSON
pubmed_extract.task: Read a clinical-trial abstract and extract the drug, condition, trial phase, number of participants and main outcome as a JSON object.
pubmed_extract.io_format: Reply with ONLY a JSON object with keys drug, condition, phase, n_participants, outcome. Use null for anything the abstract does not state. No prose, no code fences.

input.description: One PubMed abstract (plain text, 100-400 words), after the line 'Abstract:'.
input.example: Abstract: In this phase 2 randomized trial, 120 adults with type 2 diabetes received semaglutide or placebo for 24 weeks. HbA1c fell by 1.4% vs 0.2%...

output.description: A JSON object with the trial facts.

success_criteria: Output parses as JSON and has exactly the five keys
Every non-null value is stated in the abstract (no guessing)
n_participants is the number randomized/enrolled, as an integer
outcome is one sentence of at most 30 words
edge_cases: Abstract mentions several drugs (pick the intervention, not the comparator)
Phase not stated (phase must be null)
Participant count given only as per-arm numbers (sum them)
Observational study or review, not a trial (fields that do not apply are null)
pubmed_extract.system_prompt: You extract structured facts from biomedical abstracts. Reply with JSON only.

scoring.judge_rubric: For 'outcome' only: 1 if it states the same main result as the reference, else 0.
